title: GATE 6 scans only code string literals — the catalog-driven strings (crises.json display_name/preventive_redesign, demand.json set-piece id) that feed draw_text_c into the blessed banner PNGs bypass the ASCII invariant
evidence:
tools/lint.sh:54 — 'for _f in app/render/*.odin app/main.odin; do'
app/render/crisis.odin:45 — 'arch = cat.crises[ac.archetype].display_name'
app/render/crisis.odin:51 — 'sp_name = de.set_pieces[ac.set_piece].id'
app/render/crisis.odin:67 — 'draw_text_c(v, title, x, ty, 15, p.state_critical)'
app/render/crisis.odin:71 — 'redesign = cat.crises[ac.archetype].preventive_redesign'
app/render/crisis.odin:73 — 'draw_text_c(v, redesign, x, ty, 12, p.ink)'
app/render/forecast.odin:55 — 'name = de.set_pieces[f.sp_index].id'
app/render/forecast.odin:69 — 'draw_text_c(v, line, x, ty, 15, col)'
app/render/view.odin:413-415 — 'for ch in txt { append(&cbuf, u8(ch)) }'
data/crises.json:2 — '"_comment": "Crisis archetype table (ODN-4/ODN-5, story 4.2) — the DATA half of the crisis engine. ...' (the line contains literal UTF-8 em-dash bytes e2 80 94, in the non-rendered _comment field; hexdump verified)
detail: The r4 gate closes N-12 for code literals only; the banner title and redesign line render catalog strings through the same byte-truncating draw_text_c. Non-ASCII in those fields ships mojibake into blessed T2s (goldens/qos/65000ms.png) uncaught.
recommended_fix: Extend gate 6 to scan string values in data/crises.json + data/demand.json, or add an ASCII check for display_name/preventive_redesign/id at catalog load.
